questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Ukraine?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Ukraine article.

questions.proof: Its capital and largest city is Kyiv.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with Ukraine?

hints.nudge: Two countries are neighbours when you can walk from one into the other. Picture Ukraine on the globe and look at what it touches.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Ukraine article.

questions.proof: It borders Russia, Belarus, Poland, Slovakia, Hungary, Romania, and Moldova.

questions.prompt: Which language is an official language of Ukraine?

hints.nudge: An official language is the one used in schools, courts and government. The other three are spoken in other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Language” part of the Ukraine article.

questions.proof: The official language of Ukraine is Ukrainian (Ukrainian: українська мова, [ukrajin’s’ka mova]).

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “At the end of the 15th century, the groups of warriors who called themselves Cossacks appeared on the territory between the borders of _____, Muscovy, and the Crimea, in the "wild steppes" of Zaporizhia.”

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “Muscovy”. It names one thing, not an action.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Cossack State” part of the Ukraine article.

questions.proof: At the end of the 15th century, the groups of warriors who called themselves Cossacks appeared on the territory between the borders of Lithuania, Muscovy, and the Crimea, in the "wild steppes" of Zaporizhia.

questions.prompt: Fill the gap: “Cossacks also organized their own campaigns in Moldavia, Muscovy, and Crimea, on the Black Sea coast of _____ and in Asia Minor for looting.”

hints.nudge: In the sentence the missing word sits beside “coast”. It names one thing, not an action.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the “Cossack State” part of the Ukraine article.

questions.proof: Cossacks also organized their own campaigns in Moldavia, Muscovy, and Crimea, on the Black Sea coast of Bulgaria and in Asia Minor for looting.
